72-Hour Rapid Delivery Protocol

The 3-day living room transformation timeline.

01

Laser Survey & Sub-Wall Prep

Day 1: 3D laser elevation mapping, marking panel ratios around electrical outlets, laying surface drop-sheets, and chasing in-wall TV wiring channels.

02

Precision Cutting & Polymer Bonding

Day 2: 45° miter-cutting of high-density mouldings, industrial polymer adhesive fixing, acoustic perimeter caulking, and installing aluminum LED profiles.

03

Level-5 Spray & Roller Finishing

Day 3: Microfiber application of Jotun Fenomastic silk emulsion, seamless joint sanding, warm 3000K LED testing, TV bracket mounting, and zero-snag inspection.

04

Deep Clean & Handover

Handover: Full HEPA-filter vacuuming, wiping all surfaces, and instant occupancy without residual construction odor or dust.

Technical Deliverables

Engineered materials & finishing standards.

Every moulding profile and electrical fitting is selected to withstand the UAE indoor climate without warping, shrinkage, or cracks.

High-Density Polyurethane (HDPS)

Water-resistant, termite-proof, and dimensionally stable. Unlike timber or MDF, it will never warp, expand, or develop hairline cracks under continuous AC cycles.

In-Wall Conduit & Cable Chasing

In-wall conduits conceal all HDMI, optical, and high-voltage power cables behind your mounted TV, delivering an uncluttered, floating display aesthetic.

Diffused 3000K Warm LED Coves

High-CRI strip LEDs embedded inside anodized aluminum heat-sink profiles with frosted silicone diffusers produce an even, glare-free architectural halo.

Anti-Crack Elastic Joint Sealant

German-grade flexible acrylic sealants applied at all mitered 45° corner joints and wall perimeters absorb subtle building expansion without opening.

Bespoke Neoclassical & Modern Geometry

Custom panel proportions calculated to frame your artwork, mirror wall heights, and harmonize with room doors and architectural reveals.

Zero-Dust Clean Execution

Active dust-extraction miter saws and complete heavy-duty floor and furniture wrapping ensure your living space stays clean throughout the 72-hour work.

Frequently Asked Questions

Expert guidance on wall mouldings & feature walls.

Direct answers from our Abu Dhabi interior fit-out engineering and design team.

How long does it take NASAQ to complete a wall moulding and TV feature wall project?

For typical apartment living rooms and master suites up to 50 square meters, NASAQ completes the entire turnkey scope in exactly 72 hours (3 calendar days) from initial laser survey to final touch-up, electrical commissioning, and dust-free handover.

What materials are used for wall mouldings, and why not timber or MDF in the UAE?

We utilize high-density polyurethane (HDPS) and polymer architectural mouldings. Unlike wood or MDF, high-density polyurethane does not absorb ambient humidity, will not warp or expand under cycling air conditioning, resists termites, and holds crisp neoclassical lines permanently without joint cracking.

Can NASAQ completely conceal TV power cords, HDMI cables, and streaming boxes?

Yes. We build shallow flush drywall feature walls or chase fire-rated in-wall conduits so all cabling, socket extensions, and media wires are 100% hidden behind the mounted television, accompanied by integrated 3000K warm LED cove lighting.

Do we need building management NOC permits for wall mouldings in Abu Dhabi?

In major residential developments including Saadiyat Island, Al Reem Island, and Yas Island, decorative wall mouldings and interior painting are treated as non-structural cosmetic works. They require only a routine Building Management Work Permit and Gate Pass, which NASAQ coordinates on behalf of the client.

Which paint brands and sheens are applied over the mouldings?

We exclusively use premium scrub-resistant silk emulsions such as Jotun Fenomastic (Pure Colours / Wonderwall Lux) or Caparol, applied after sealing all mitered joints with German-grade flexible acrylic caulk for a seamless Level-5 finish.

Can I choose custom frame designs and asymmetrical layouts?

Yes. Our site engineers produce customized 2D elevation shop drawings showing exact box widths, chair rail heights, and spacing around switches and artwork before any cuts are made on site.
